name: AssemblyAI
description: AssemblyAI's pricing page covers speech-to-text, text-to-speech and an LLM Gateway, with a free tier and pay-as-you-go per-hour rates.
features: EU region at the same price as the US
strengths: $50 in free credits at signup, no credit card required
EU region costs the same as the US region
limitations: Free-tier streaming concurrency is limited to 5 new streams per minute

plans.name: Free tier
highlights: Up to 185 hours pre-recorded and 333 hours streaming transcription

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.note: Billed monthly on actual usage, in USD; no minimum commitment. Starting limit 100 new streams per minute.

free.details: No credit card needed to start. The pricing page says the free tier includes up to 185 hours of pre-recorded transcription and up to 333 hours of streaming transcription; 5 new streaming connections per minute.

api.summary: Pre-recorded speech-to-text per hour: Universal-3.5 Pro $0.21, Universal-2 $0.15. Text-to-Speech $15 per 1M input characters. Streaming per-hour prices are on the Realtime tab, which was not re-read.

pricing.regional: The EU region costs the same as the US region (endpoints api.eu.assemblyai.com and streaming.eu.assemblyai.com). Tax treatment: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active (speech-to-text, understanding and text-to-speech APIs). Pricing page lists pay-as-you-go per-hour rates and a custom tier. Corrected: the free tier is now described as up to 185 hours of pre-recorded and 333 hours of streaming transcription (the old '$50 credit' wording was not on the page). Streaming per-hour prices sit on a separate tab that was not re-read.
